Hi Jared — thanks again for making time today. Quick readout from our side and three asks so we keep momentum: 

Recap (from demo + discovery)
- Primary use case: customer support triage + knowledge retrieval (pilot scope)
- Important constraints: data residency for logs, per-request latency target ~200ms P95, pilot expected to ingest ~1.2M tokens/month
- Success criteria: reduce avg handle time by 20% and integrate with existing search stack

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the fiscal owner / economic buyer for this initiative (name + best contact)? we want to align the commercial proposal to the person who signs off.
2) Introduce us to procurement/security contact so we can send SOC2 + standard DSAR and our procurement questionnaire (we attached a short questionnaire to speed review).
3) What is the expected procurement timeline and any blackout windows (e.g., Q-end budget freezes)?

What we attached: Redwood-Security-OnePager.pdf (summary SOC2 + controls), Redwood-Procurement-Questions.xlsx (short questionnaire) — both should help your team triage.

If it's helpful, I can draft a 15-min intro email template for the economic buyer and loop Marissa (AE) to share a high-level pricing snapshot in advance. Suggested cadence: intro call this week -> procurement Q&A next week -> pilot SOW in 3–4 weeks (if all looks good).

Thanks — OLGA

Hi Olga — great session this afternoon, clear and pragmatic. Short answers below to keep things moving.

1) Economic buyer / fiscal owner: Sarah Kim (CFO) — sarah.kim@novahq.com. She signs off on initiatives > $50k and reviews proposals monthly on the first Tuesday.
2) Procurement / security: Priya Desai is our procurement lead (cc'd). She owns vendor questionnaire triage and standard contract redlines. For any security evidence ask, send links and Priya will route to our InfoSec reviewer.
3) Timeline: FY27 Q3 budget window opens June 15; procurement prefers initial SOWs before July 10 to get included in the Q3 plan. Expect a 2–3 week procurement back-and-forth for standard pilots.

A couple of additional notes:
- Sarah will want a simple cost/benefit note (one pager) that highlights cost by tier (hosted vs dedicated) and estimated ROI impact — if you can provide a ballpark number by EOD tomorrow, that will help secure the intro.
- Priya asked if you can share a direct link to your SOC2 report and a version of the procurement questionnaire filled in (we sometimes get slow on the vendor side if we have to draft answers).

Attached: Novah_Procurement_Requirements_v2.docx (internal list for your reference). Happy to intro Sarah once we have the pricing snapshot and the SOC2 link.

Thanks — Jared
